title: Make inquiry lifecycle and quotation creation authorized and atomic
description: Stage3 core business workflow integrity. Use genuine authenticated existing ERP permissions; no new user grants or anonymous/admin fallback. Retain inventory source document audit and original failed logs. Run relevant unit tests and safe Release build/full unit suite. Real SQL must target exact (localdb)\NEWERP_AutoAcceptance with IntegratedSecurity and a new GUID-owned NEWERP_AUTOTEST database; reject existing/wrong target before access, never drop/reset or read production settings. Include two independent connection race tests where applicable. Build completion never implies stage acceptance.
acceptance_criteria: Implement reusable inquiry live enabled identity/existing inquiry menu/customer scope authority across all CRUD, lifecycle, batch, export and prefill/conversion endpoints. Quotation creation additionally requires existing quotation menu and target customer scope; original and proposed customers checked on update. Counts/paging/export scoped before reads; no new grants or reliance on text ownership. Preserve existing source eligibility, inquiry details and current calculation/quantity/unit semantics.

Serialize edit/submit/approve/cancel/delete/batch and to-quotation under deterministic inquiry-to-quotation lock order compatible with quotation mutations; transaction and source reread before duplicate check/number/draft. Same inquiry produces at most one full quotation per existing rule, converted source cannot be reopened or invalidated while live downstream exists; no downstream automatic reversal. Two independent SQL connections duplicate conversion, cancel/conversion, edit/approve, mixed batch and DB failure; source-only/target-only/revoked/disabled/foreign denials zero mutation. Unit existing inquiry conversion regressions and safe Release/full unit; browser evidence or exact blocker.

implementation_evidence: InquiryController selected reads use ResolveScopeAsync but mutation and prefill/to-quotation do not explicitly enforce live source/target menus. ToQuotation builds draft and generates number before rereading inquiry and inserting quotation/marking completed in SaveChanges without source-row transaction or duplicate serialization.
